purpose: Authorize zero-cost independent exact-head code-review providers when Codex/Copilot are unavailable, without weakening owner self-audit, exact-head CI, review-thread, change-request, or drift requirements.
effectiveAfter: This governance amendment is merged to main. Provider implementation must then start from that accepted main and remain inside the finite path set below.
requiredInvariants: Codex and GitHub Copilot remain valid providers when available; owner self-audit never counts as independent review.
Octopus Review may remain an optional provider but its service failure or indexing state can never satisfy review authority.

The local semantic reviewer is Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct-GGUF at exact Hugging Face revision aebf6a0f72261b12fb8199bc580fe172fe86c901, file qwen2.5-coder-3b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf, SHA-256 724fb256bec1ff062b2f65e4569e871ad2e95ab2a3989723d1769c54294730b7.

Local inference uses llama.cpp build b10809 from source commit 5266f24da75dc449bd56cbed7addb9c8e4a6a73e; Ubuntu x64 archive llama-b10809-bin-ubuntu-x64.tar.gz must match SHA-256 5e34434ddc6d03cd1584f403201aff0d4bd1a5793a72ff7e286532dfd1e4b941 before extraction.

No model or inference binary selected through a floating tag, mutable main branch, unverified package installer, external AI API, paid plan, secret purchase, or account credential may satisfy review authority.

The local-Qwen workflow must execute trusted main workflow code under pull_request_target, same-repository open non-draft PRs only, and must never checkout or execute PR-head code; PR content is review text only.
The review prompt, model revision, artifact hashes, runtime build, temperature, seed, output schema and PASS criteria are fixed in trusted workflow code and cannot be selected by the PR.
Inference must use deterministic settings including temperature zero and a fixed seed; malformed, truncated or non-JSON model output fails closed.

Model output must be strict JSON with verdict PASS or BLOCK, a findings array, severity/path/line/title/reason fields, and a bounded summary. Clean authority requires verdict PASS and findings=[] exactly.

Any model finding, BLOCK verdict, artifact hash mismatch, download failure, inference failure, timeout, context overflow, stale PR head, or output validation failure must publish no clean attestation and must fail closed.

A successful local-Qwen review must publish BOTH a structured exact-head PR review and matching exact-head review-provider/local-qwen commit status, bound to the current head, model SHA-256, llama archive SHA-256, trusted prompt SHA-256, response SHA-256, and workflow run id.

The verifier must require the paired structured review plus matching latest successful provider status; github-actions[bot] by itself, an owner comment, a stale review, or an arbitrary status is never sufficient.

Existing exact-head substantive CI, repository-owner self-audit, active CHANGES_REQUESTED, unresolved current review-thread, exact-head snapshot and final live-head recheck remain mandatory and fail closed.
No MACHINE_FALLBACK, owner-posted provider PASS, arbitrary bot authority, prefix-only authority, stale-head authority, or fabricated independent evidence is authorized.

The local model provider is an independent semantic reviewer because the reviewer model weights and inference runtime are third-party immutable artifacts and the PR cannot modify their identity, prompt, execution or PASS threshold.
No registration, authentication, database, application-domain, PostHog runtime, REG.RU production, deployment or user-facing behavior is changed by this governance amendment.
No new runtime npm dependency or recurring paid service is introduced; public GitHub-hosted Actions execution and public model/runtime downloads are the only infrastructure used.
New recurring cost is exactly 0 rubles.
